description: This file defines the Exception class for SuiteCRM, extending PHP's built-in Exception class, and includes methods for retrieving exception details and log level. It is part of the SuiteCRM exception handling subsystem.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\Exception\Exception
classes.description: Custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception, with additional methods for detail and log level.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that prepends '[SuiteCRM]' to the message and calls parent constructor.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Returns a string indicating an unhandled exception in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getLogLevel
methods.description: Returns the log level 'CRITICAL' for this exception.
